## Sitemaps

## Pages
- [E-commerce Development](https://1digitech.com/ecommerce-development): Bilingual online stores for UAE brands: custom platforms you fully own, with any feature you need and yearly support.
- [AI Solutions](https://1digitech.com/ai-solutions): AI Solutions in Dubai · Live in 6 Weeks
- [Social Media Management](https://1digitech.com/social-management): Social Media Agency in Dubai · Video-First
- [Google Ads / PPC](https://1digitech.com/google-ads-ppc): Google Ads Agency in Dubai · ROI-First
- [SEO](https://1digitech.com/seo): SEO Agency in Dubai · AI-First Search
- [About](https://1digitech.com/about): About OneDigitech · Deira, Dubai · Founded 2022
- [Clients](https://1digitech.com/clients): OneDigitech clients
- [Contact](https://1digitech.com/contact): Contact OneDigitech · Online now · Reply within 24h
- [Partners](https://1digitech.com/partners): OneDigitech partners
- [Testmonial](https://1digitech.com/testmonial): Client voices

## Services
- [UI/UX Design](https://1digitech.com/service/user-experience-design): Interface design for websites and apps: wireframes, clickable prototypes, design systems and polished screens in Arabic and English.
- [Digital Strategy](https://1digitech.com/service/digital-strategy): A clear digital marketing plan built on research: your audience, competitors, the right channels, budget and a 90-day action plan.
- [Branding](https://1digitech.com/service/branding): Brand strategy, positioning, naming and messaging that make your business clear, memorable and easy to choose.
- [Website & Video Translation](https://1digitech.com/service/translating-content-of-websites-videos): Arabic-English website translation, multilingual SEO, video subtitles and voice-over, localised for UAE and GCC audiences.
- [Hosting, Domains & Business Email](https://1digitech.com/service/hosting-domain-and-official-e-mails): Fast, secure hosting, .ae and .com domain registration, SSL and professional business email, all managed for you.
- [Website Maintenance & Support](https://1digitech.com/service/technical-support): WordPress updates, security hardening, backups, uptime monitoring and fast fixes, handled by our support team every month.
- [Motion Graphics](https://1digitech.com/service/motion-graphics): Animated explainer videos, logo animations, social media motion design and animated ads, scripted and voiced in Arabic and English.
- [Content Writing](https://1digitech.com/service/exclusive-writing-content): Original website copy, blogs, product descriptions and ad copy, written natively in Arabic and English and optimised for search.
- [Visual Identity](https://1digitech.com/service/visual-identity): Logo design and a complete visual identity: colour palette, typography, icons, templates and brand guidelines for print and digital.
- [3D & Virtual Reality](https://1digitech.com/service/3d-virtual-reality-implementation): 3D and 360° virtual tours, product visualisation and VR experiences that let customers explore your space or product online.
- [Influencer Marketing](https://1digitech.com/service/influencer-marketing): Find, brief and manage the right UAE influencers for your brand, with clear contracts, approvals and measurable results.
- [Video Marketing](https://1digitech.com/service/video-marketing): Short-form video for Reels, TikTok and YouTube plus video ads: concepts, filming, editing and distribution.
- [Conversion Rate Optimization](https://1digitech.com/service/conversion-rate-optimization): Get more leads and sales from the traffic you already have, through analytics audits, UX fixes, better landing pages and A/B testing.
- [User Experience (UX) Design](https://1digitech.com/service/user-experience): UX research, journey mapping and usability testing that find what frustrates your users and fix it before you build.
- [Digital Strategy Consulting](https://1digitech.com/service/digital-strategy-consulting): Practical digital transformation consulting: audit your processes, choose the right systems, add AI and automation, and roll it out step by step.
- [Analytics and Reporting](https://1digitech.com/service/analytics-and-reporting): GA4, Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking set up properly, with dashboards that show which channels bring in leads.
- [Custom E-commerce Platform](https://1digitech.com/service/custom-ecommerce-platform): A fully featured online store built just for you: your own code, database and media storage, a bilingual storefront, any feature you need and yearly support.
- [E-commerce Solutions](https://1digitech.com/service/e-commerce-solutions): Shopify and WooCommerce stores built to sell in the UAE, with local payment gateways, shipping, Arabic support and marketing tools.
- [Mobile App Development](https://1digitech.com/service/mobile-app-development): iOS and Android apps from idea to App Store launch: UX, native or cross-platform development, APIs, payments and ongoing support.
- [Content Marketing](https://1digitech.com/service/content-marketing): Content strategy, SEO blogs, guides and social content in Arabic and English that bring in search traffic and build trust.
- [Pay-Per-Click (PPC) Advertising](https://1digitech.com/service/pay-per-click-ppc-advertising): PPC campaigns on Google, Meta and LinkedIn that bring in leads you can measure, with proper tracking and weekly optimisation.
- [Email Marketing](https://1digitech.com/service/email-marketing): Email campaigns and automations that nurture leads, welcome new customers and bring past customers back.
- [Search Engine Optimization](https://1digitech.com/service/search-engine-optimization): Local SEO that puts your business in front of nearby customers on Google Search and Google Maps, from your Business Profile to fast, well-structured pages.
- [Website Design & Development](https://1digitech.com/service/website-design-and-development): Fast, mobile-first websites in Arabic and English, built to rank on Google and turn visitors into enquiries.
- [Social Media Marketing](https://1digitech.com/service/social-media-marketing): Organic and paid social media marketing on Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and LinkedIn: strategy, content, Reels and ads with monthly reporting.

## Blog
- [How can a digital marketing company improve your business?](https://1digitech.com/blog/can-digital-marketing-company-improve-your-business): How can a digital marketing company improve your business? By bringing strategy, specialist skills and data to every channel, from SEO services to social media and email. This guide explains the steps a professional agency takes to turn online activity into growth.
- [web designing companies in dubai](https://1digitech.com/blog/web-designing-companies-in-dubai): Comparing web designing companies in Dubai can feel overwhelming, because hundreds of agencies promise great results. The factors below will help you shortlist the right partner, the same standards our web design team holds itself to.
- [Digital Marketing Agency Pricing in Dubai](https://1digitech.com/blog/digital-marketing-agency-pricing-in-dubai): Digital marketing agency pricing in Dubai depends on agency size, the services you need and the results you expect. This guide breaks down the pricing models and cost structure, including SEO, social media and Google Ads management, so you can budget with confidence.
- [basic seo packages in dubai](https://1digitech.com/blog/basic-seo-packages-in-dubai): Basic SEO packages in Dubai are a practical way for small businesses to start ranking without a large retainer. But what is actually included varies a lot between providers. This guide explains the essentials every package should cover and how to choose the right level of SEO services.
- [social media services in dubai](https://1digitech.com/blog/social-media-services-in-dubai): Choosing between social media services in Dubai starts with knowing where your customers spend time and what each platform does best. This review covers the main platforms, current trends and how to compare providers of social media management, so you invest where it actually brings enquiries.
- [How Much Does SEO Cost In Dubai](https://1digitech.com/blog/how-much-does-seo-cost-in-dubai): How much does SEO cost in Dubai? Prices range from small monthly packages to large retainers, and the right budget depends on your competition and goals. This guide explains what drives the cost, what a solid strategy includes and how to judge the value of SEO services.
- [Protect WordPress Website From Hackers or Viruses?](https://1digitech.com/blog/how-to-protect-your-wordpress-website-from-hackers-or-viruses): If you run your business on WordPress, you need a plan to protect your WordPress website from hackers. Most attacks are automated and look for outdated plugins, weak passwords and missing backups. These 10 essential tips cover the basics our web design team puts in place on every site we maintain.
- [Best Payment Gateways for eCommerce Websites in UAE](https://1digitech.com/blog/best-payment-gateways-for-ecommerce-websites-in-uae): Choosing the right payment gateways for ecommerce websites in the UAE affects your conversion rate, your fees and your customers' trust. A smooth, secure checkout in dirhams, with cards and digital wallets, can be the difference between a sale and an abandoned cart. This guide compares the main options, based on how our e-commerce solutions team integrates them.
- [The Importance of Content in Web Design](https://1digitech.com/blog/the-importance-of-content-in-web-design): The importance of content in web design is easy to underestimate. A beautiful layout cannot sell on its own: visitors stay for clear headlines, useful information and stories that make them trust you. This guide shows how our web design team combines content and design to turn a bland site into a brilliant one.
- [Website Optimization: Why Speed Matters](https://1digitech.com/blog/website-optimization-why-speed-matters): Website optimization for speed is one of the highest-return improvements you can make. Slow pages lose visitors, rank lower in Google and convert fewer enquiries, especially on mobile. Below we explain why speed matters and share 7 proven fixes our web design team uses.
- [pricing for digital marketing services in dubai](https://1digitech.com/blog/pricing-for-digital-marketing-services-in-dubai): Pricing for digital marketing services in Dubai can look confusing, because every agency packages its work differently. This guide explains the factors that drive cost, the common pricing models and what to expect for SEO, social media and Google Ads management.
- [best seo expert in dubai](https://1digitech.com/blog/best-seo-expert-in-dubai): Finding the best SEO expert in Dubai can transform how many customers find you on Google. But SEO skills are hard to judge from the outside. This guide covers the 5 qualities that matter, the steps to hire well and how SEO services should be measured.
- [responsive web design dubai](https://1digitech.com/blog/responsive-web-design-dubai): Responsive web design means your website adapts automatically to every screen, from a phone to a wide desktop monitor. In Dubai, where most browsing happens on mobile, it is no longer optional. This guide covers the benefits, the 5 essential features and how our web design team builds responsive sites.
- [low cost digital marketing uae](https://1digitech.com/blog/low-cost-digital-marketing-uae): Low cost digital marketing does not mean cheap results. It means spending a small budget where it brings the most customers. For UAE businesses, that usually starts with free foundations such as Google Business Profile and basic SEO services, then adds paid channels only once they are proven. Here are the 7 steps to build that plan.
- [conversion rate optimization service in dubai](https://1digitech.com/blog/conversion-rate-optimization-service-in-dubai): A conversion rate optimization service in Dubai helps you earn more leads and sales from the traffic you already pay for. Before increasing ad spend or Google Ads management budgets, it is usually cheaper to fix the pages that leak visitors. This guide explains how CRO works and how to measure it.
- [how much does a social media agency charge in dubai](https://1digitech.com/blog/how-much-does-a-social-media-agency-charge-in-dubai): How much does a social media agency charge in Dubai? The honest answer is that it depends on the platforms, the amount of content and whether paid ads are included. This guide breaks down the pricing models and cost drivers, so you can compare quotes for social media management like for like.
- [benefits of digital marketing for startups in Dubai](https://1digitech.com/blog/benefits-of-digital-marketing-for-startups-in-dubai): Digital marketing for startups in Dubai has one job: find paying customers quickly without burning runway. The UAE is highly connected and very competitive, so the startups that win pick a few channels, measure everything and improve weekly. Here are the 7 steps we use, from early SEO services to paid campaigns.
- [top Advertising Agency in Dubai](https://1digitech.com/blog/top-advertising-agency-in-dubai): Finding the top advertising agency in Dubai for your brand means looking past awards and showreels to results, process and fit. This guide covers the characteristics of strong agencies, the services they offer, from creative to Google Ads management, and the questions that reveal who can really grow your business.
- [best advertising agency dubai 2024](https://1digitech.com/blog/best-advertising-agency-dubai): The best advertising agency for your brand is not just a supplier. It is a partner that understands the Dubai market and works closely with your team. This guide explains how collaboration with an agency, from creative to Google Ads management, can take your brand further.
- [Top SEO Agency in Dubai Stay Ahead of the Competition](https://1digitech.com/blog/top-seo-agency-in-dubai): Working with a top SEO agency in Dubai is one of the most reliable ways to win customers who are already searching for what you sell. This guide explains what an agency actually does, how to compare providers of SEO services, and how SEO keeps you ahead of competitors.
- [Companies That Benefit from Digital Marketing](https://1digitech.com/blog/companies-that-benefit-from-digital-marketing): The companies that benefit from digital marketing range from two-person startups to multinational groups. Each uses it differently, but all gain the same thing: customers who find them online. This guide shows how businesses of every size use SEO services, social media and automation to grow.
- [pay per lead Dubai : Dominate Your Market](https://1digitech.com/blog/pay-per-lead-dubai): Pay per lead advertising lets you pay for results, a qualified enquiry, instead of clicks or impressions. For businesses in Dubai that know what a customer is worth, it is a predictable way to grow. Here is how it works, how it compares with Google Ads management and how to set it up properly.
- [The Top Advertising Agency Trends in Dubai](https://1digitech.com/blog/advertising-agency-dubai): The biggest advertising agency trends in Dubai are being driven by data, mobile behaviour and AI. Brands that adapt early reach customers more precisely and spend less per sale. Here are the 6 shifts shaping campaigns in the UAE, and how they affect everything from creative to Google Ads management.
- [Best SEO Agency in Dubai](https://1digitech.com/blog/best-seo-agency-in-dubai): Choosing the best SEO agency in Dubai can boost your online presence for years, while the wrong one can waste budget or even harm your site. This guide explains what SEO is, the benefits of expert SEO services and 5 proven ways to choose the right partner.
- [hiring a digital marketing agency in dubai](https://1digitech.com/blog/hiring-a-digital-marketing-agency-in-dubai): Hiring a digital marketing agency in Dubai can give your business specialist skills, tools and speed that are hard to build in-house. But agencies differ hugely in quality and approach. This guide explains what agencies do, from SEO services to paid ads, how to choose one and how to judge the return.
- [Pricing Models of Marketing Agencies in Dubai](https://1digitech.com/blog/pricing-models-of-marketing-agencies-in-dubai): Understanding the pricing models of marketing agencies helps you compare quotes fairly and avoid paying for the wrong thing. Agencies in Dubai typically charge hourly, per project, by monthly retainer or by results. Below we explain each option and when it makes sense, whether you need SEO, social media or Google Ads management.
- [successful web design in Dubai](https://1digitech.com/blog/discover-the-secrets-behind-successful-web-design-in-dubai): Successful web design in Dubai is less about following trends and more about results: fast pages, mobile-first layouts, Arabic and English content, and an obvious path to contact you. Below we break down what separates sites that win customers from sites that only look good. It is the same checklist our web design team applies to every build.
- [Web Designing Company in Dubai : Factors to Consider](https://1digitech.com/blog/choosing-perfect-web-designing-company-in-dubai): Choosing a web designing company in Dubai is a decision that affects your sales for years. Your website is often the first impression a customer has of your business. These 6 essential factors will help you compare agencies, including our own web design team, on what really matters.
- [the power of Video marketing](https://1digitech.com/blog/the-power-of-video-marketing): Video marketing has become one of the most effective ways for brands in the UAE to stop the scroll, explain an offer and win trust quickly. Short reels, product demos and customer stories now drive a large share of engagement on Instagram, TikTok and YouTube. Here is how to plan video that sells, and how our social media management team approaches it.
- [What’s Digital Marketing](https://1digitech.com/blog/whats-digital-marketing): Digital marketing is how businesses reach and convert customers through online channels: search engines, social media, email, websites and mobile apps. This simple guide explains where it came from, the channels that matter today and how UAE businesses can start, whether with SEO services, social media or paid ads.
- [digital marketing cost in dubai](https://1digitech.com/blog/cost-of-digital-marketing-in-dubai): The cost of digital marketing in Dubai depends on which channels you use, how competitive your industry is and how fast you want results. Below we explain the main services, from SEO to Google Ads management, what each one typically costs and how to measure whether it pays for itself.

## Packages
- [STARTER Package](https://1digitech.com/package/starter-package): Our starter social media package gives small businesses in Dubai a consistent, professional presence on Facebook and Instagram without hiring an in-house team. It starts with a free consultation, then we plan, design, write and publish your content every month and report on what worked.
- [ESSENTIAL Package](https://1digitech.com/package/standard-package): The Essential plan is our social media package with paid ads for Dubai businesses that want to reach new customers, not just post for existing followers. It includes everything in the Starter package, plus paid campaigns, extra channels and deeper analytics.
- [PLUS Package](https://1digitech.com/package/plus-package): The Plus plan is our TikTok management package for Dubai brands that want short-form video to do the heavy lifting. It includes everything in the Essential package, plus TikTok and YouTube management, six TikTok videos and a professional video shoot.
- [ULTIMATE Package](https://1digitech.com/package/premium-package): The Ultimate plan is our complete digital marketing package in Dubai: social media, video, a business website and SEO handled by one team. It includes everything in the Plus package, plus a website, SEO optimisation, Google Business Profile setup and a monthly SEO report.
- [Essential Website Package](https://1digitech.com/package/basic-website-package): Our Essential plan is a simple, fast website package in Dubai for small businesses and professionals who need a credible online presence. It includes a year of domain and hosting, a mobile-friendly design, up to five pages, basic SEO and analytics.
- [E-Commerce Website Package](https://1digitech.com/package/e-commerce-website-package): Our ecommerce website package gives Dubai businesses a ready-to-sell online store: product pages, a shopping cart, payment gateways and inventory management, on dedicated hosting with SSL. It includes everything in the Essential Website package, built for selling.
- [ESSENTIAL SEO Package](https://1digitech.com/package/basic-seo-package): Our Essential plan is an affordable SEO package in Dubai for local businesses that want to appear when customers search on Google. It covers keyword research, on-page and technical SEO, content optimisation and a monthly report with a consultation.
- [ADVANCED SEO Package](https://1digitech.com/package/advanced-seo-package): Our advanced SEO package is for Dubai businesses competing for valuable, crowded keywords. It goes deeper than the Essential plan, with competitor analysis, comprehensive on-page and technical work, a content strategy and high-quality link building.

## Projects
- [Dubai Shopper](https://1digitech.com/project/dubai-shopper): A bilingual ecommerce website built from scratch for a Dubai multi-brand retailer: English and Arabic storefront, admin console, Stripe payments and their own code and data.
- [Gulf Wings Travel](https://1digitech.com/project/gulf): How we run travel agency social media for Gulf Wings Travel: planning, fast package promotions, branded designs, Reels and monthly analytics.
- [Tabra General Trading](https://1digitech.com/project/tabra-general-trading): A trading company website built from scratch with SEO foundations, plus social media strategy, content and reporting for Tabra General Trading.
- [Hope Vet](https://1digitech.com/project/hope-vet): Full-funnel veterinary clinic digital marketing for Hope Vet: strategy, pet-centric content, social media, media buying, Google Ads and reporting.
- [Amani Travel](https://1digitech.com/project/amani-travel): An AI travel booking chatbot on WhatsApp and web, a package management system, a new website and ongoing social media for Amani Travel & Tourism.
- [Bin Ham Travel](https://1digitech.com/project/binham-travel): A travel agency WhatsApp chatbot that sends direct booking links, plus social media strategy, content, Reels and media buying for Bin Ham Travel.

## About OneDigitech
OneDigitech is a digital marketing agency in Dubai, UAE (founded 2022). It combines SEO and Generative Engine Optimization, Google Ads / PPC, social media management and custom AI solutions (AI chatbots, WhatsApp automation) into one growth system for UAE businesses in travel, healthcare, hospitality, retail and professional services.

- Address: 22A Street, Deira, Port Saeed, Dubai - UAE
- WhatsApp / phone: +971 50 811 4930
- Email: contact@1digitech.com
- Service area: Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah and all seven UAE emirates

## Core services
- [SEO & GEO](https://1digitech.com/seo)
- [Google Ads & PPC](https://1digitech.com/google-ads-ppc)
- [Social media management](https://1digitech.com/social-management)

- [Packages & prices](https://1digitech.com/package)
- [Case studies](https://1digitech.com/case-studies)
